header: Today's headlines, live: the Business tab first (The Economic Times, Mint, The Hindu BusinessLine, The Wall Street Journal), then Steel (SAIL and every steel plant, hunted in many papers), then English, Hindi and Bengali, from the publishers' own free feeds. I made it keep itself current: every minute it asks again, quietly (nothing is replaced by a loading box), and the new stories slide in at the top of a list that does not jump (LiveStories.tsx). Checking pauses while the page is hidden and can be paused by hand (LiveStrip.tsx). Headlines and links only; each story opens on the publisher's page in a new tab; the feeds that did not answer are named. Nothing typed is sent anywhere (the request carries only the tab).

symbols.name: NEWS_REFRESH_MS
doc: How often the open tab asks again: the route keeps one answer for a minute, so a faster pace would only ask for the same answer.

symbols.name: SteelNote
doc: The lines under the Steel tab: what it hunts, how long a story stays, how many papers carried what is shown, and the engines or papers that did not answer.
